title: Smoked Salmon Tea Sandwich
description: A classic tea sandwich recipe featuring smoked salmon, perfect for a light and refreshing snack.
instructions: 1. Lay out the thinly sliced bread on a clean surface.
2. Spread a thin layer of mustardy spread on each slice of bread.
3. Arrange a slice of smoked salmon on top of the spread.
4. Sprinkle crumbled Scottish cheddar cheese on top of the salmon (if using).
5. Place another slice of bread on top to create a sandwich.
6. Cut the sandwiches into smaller pieces or use a cookie cutter to create fun shapes.
